description: Ghost-text continuation for fiction that reads your lore, characters, outline and previous chapters; hover a name to see its card.
command.showLastRequest: Show Last Request to the Model
config.enabled: Show ghost-text continuations. The status bar item toggles this.
config.trigger: When to ask the model for a continuation.
config.trigger.auto: After a pause, when the cursor is at the end of a line in a chapter file. **Alt+\\** also asks anywhere in Markdown or plain text.
config.trigger.manual: Only when you press **Alt+\\** (Trigger Inline Suggestion).
config.debounceMs: How long to wait after you stop typing before a request is sent, in milliseconds.
config.maxSuggestionChars: Longest ghost text, in characters. A suggestion normally ends at its first sentence end before reaching this.
config.provider: Where requests go. Set the key with **Novel Helper: Set or Clear API Key**.
config.provider.openaiCompatible: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, such as a local model (set `#novelHelper.openaiCompatible.baseUrl#`)
config.anthropic.model: Model for the Anthropic provider. Requests turn thinking off with `"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}`; for a model that rejects this, change `thinking` in `#novelHelper.extraRequestBody#`.
config.openai.model: Model for the OpenAI provider. Requests send `"reasoning_effort": "none"`.
config.deepseek.model: Model for the DeepSeek provider. Requests turn thinking off with `"thinking": {"type": "disabled"}`.
config.gemini.model: Model for the Gemini provider. Gemini 3 models cannot turn thinking off; Flash-Lite thinks at the `minimal` level by default.
config.openaiCompatible.baseUrl: Base URL, up to `/v1`, for the OpenAI-compatible provider. Ollama: `http://localhost:11434/v1`; LM Studio: `http://localhost:1234/v1`.
config.openaiCompatible.model: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible provider.
config.extraRequestBody: Fields merged into every request body after the provider's own. `null` removes a field the provider would send, e.g. `{"thinking": null}`.
config.files.lore: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, for lore files: one entry per file. The file name is the entry name; frontmatter can set `name`, `aliases`, `type`, `always` and `summary`.
config.files.chapters: Glob patterns for chapter files, one chapter per file. Chapters are ordered by path with numbers compared by value: 第2章 before 第10章, 第九章 before 第十二章.
config.files.outlines: Glob patterns for chapter outlines. An outline belongs to the chapter with the same file name.
config.files.summaries: Glob patterns for chapter summaries. A summary belongs to the chapter with the same file name; a previous chapter without one contributes its last lines instead.
config.context.beforeChars: Characters of text before the cursor sent to the model.
config.context.afterChars: Characters of text after the cursor sent to the model.
config.context.scanChars: Characters before the cursor searched for lore names and aliases.
config.context.alwaysChars: Budget, in characters, for entries marked `always: true`.
config.context.matchedChars: Budget, in characters, for entries named near the cursor or in this chapter's outline. Entries mentioned closer to the cursor and more often go in first.
config.context.entryChars: Most characters taken from one entry: its `summary`, or the start of its text.
config.context.outlineChars: Most characters taken from this chapter's outline.
config.context.previousChapters: How many previous chapters to include.
config.context.previousChapterChars: Most characters per previous chapter: its summary, or the end of the chapter when it has none.
untrustedWorkspaces: In Restricted Mode, provider, model, base URL and extra request fields come from user settings only, so an untrusted folder cannot redirect your text or key.
